nodes.summary: The atoms of the two-channel filter bank with filters $h, g$ on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$ are the $2N$ even translates $\tau_{2n} h$ (low-pass) and $\tau_{2n} g$ (high-pass), $0 \le n < N$, indexed by two copies of $\{0, \dots, N-1\}$. The analysis coefficients of $x$ are its inner products with these atoms.
nodes.title: Atoms of the two-channel filter bank

nodes.summary: If the atoms $\tau_{2n} h, \tau_{2n} g$ ($0 \le n < N$) of a two-channel filter bank on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$ are orthonormal, they form an orthonormal basis: there are $2N$ of them in a space of dimension $2N$.
nodes.title: The atoms of an orthonormal filter bank form an orthonormal basis

nodes.summary: For signals $h, x$ on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$, At $s = 2n$ this is the subsampled filter output $(x \star \bar h)[2n]$ with $\bar h[k] = \overline{h[-k]}$, the analysis coefficient of the two-channel filter bank in Mallat's pyramidal algorithm (S. Mallat, *A theory for multiresolution signal decomposition: the wavelet representation*, IEEE Trans. Pattern Anal. Mach. Intell. 11 (1989)).
nodes.title: Filtering and subsampling as an inner product

nodes.summary: For signals $x, y$ on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$, $\langle \tau_s x, \tau_t y\rangle = \sum_k \overline{x[k]}\, y[k + s - t]$: the inner product of two translates depends only on $s - t$, and is a value of the cross-correlation of $x$ and $y$.
nodes.title: Inner product of two translates

nodes.summary: For a low-pass filter $h$ on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$, the mirror high-pass filter is If $H(\omega) = \sum_k h[k] e^{-ik\omega}$ and $G(\omega) = \sum_k g[k] e^{-ik\omega}$, then $G(\omega) = e^{-i\omega}\, \overline{H(\omega + \pi)}$, the choice (69) of S. Mallat, *Multiresolution approximations and wavelet orthonormal bases of $L^2(\mathbb{R})$*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 315 (1989), Section 4.
nodes.title: Mirror high-pass filter

nodes.summary: Under the hypothesis of perfect reconstruction, the low-pass and high-pass halves split the energy of the signal. This is the finite periodic form of the orthogonality identity $\int_0^{2\pi} |a|^2 = \int_0^\pi |b|^2 + \int_0^\pi |c|^2$ in Section 4 of S. Mallat, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 315 (1989).
nodes.title: Energy conservation of the orthogonal two-channel filter bank

nodes.summary: If the even translates $\tau_{2n} h$ ($0 \le n < N$) of a filter $h$ on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$ are orthonormal, then with the mirror filter $g[k] = (-1)^{1-k}\overline{h[1-k]}$ the whole family $\tau_{2n} h, \tau_{2n} g$ is orthonormal, so perfect reconstruction applies. The even translates of $g$ have the same correlations as those of $h$ (reindex $k \mapsto 1 - 2e - k$), and each $\tau_{2m} h$ is orthogonal to each…
nodes.title: Conjugate mirror filters give an orthonormal two-channel filter bank

nodes.summary: The sign $(-1)^k$ for $k \in \mathbb{Z}/2N$, computed from the representative of $k$ in $\{0, \dots, 2N-1\}$; it is multiplicative, $(-1)^{a+b} = (-1)^a (-1)^b$, because $2N$ is even.
nodes.title: Parity sign

nodes.summary: Let $h, g$ be filters on $\mathbb{Z}/2N$ whose even translates $\tau_{2n} h, \tau_{2n} g$ ($0 \le n < N$) are orthonormal. Then every signal $x$ is recovered from its subsampled filter outputs $a[n] = \langle \tau_{2n} h, x\rangle$ and $d[n] = \langle \tau_{2n} g, x\rangle$: This is the finite periodic form of the orthogonal decomposition $a(\omega) = b(\omega)H(\omega) + c(\omega)G(\omega)$ of S. Mallat,…
nodes.title: Perfect reconstruction of the orthogonal two-channel filter bank

nodes.summary: For a signal $x$ on the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}/2N$ and $s \in \mathbb{Z}/2N$, the translate is $\tau_s x[k] = x[k - s]$.
nodes.title: Cyclic translate

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
